title: Stability of strong global and exponential attractors for semilinear beam equations with fractional damping and memory
summary: This paper investigates the stability of strong global and exponential attractors for a semilinear beam equation with memory and fractional damping, where $α\in[0,2]$ denotes the fractional damping exponent and $β\in[0,1]$ the memory parameter. After showing the existence of a strong global attractor, we prove its upper semicontinuity in the parameter pair $(α,β)$. We then construct a family of strong exponential attractors and establish its continuity in $(α,β)$.
